definitions.explanation: The legal rights and responsibilities of a parent over their minor child, including decisions about education, residence, and welfare. In Japanese law, custody disputes in divorce are particularly significant.

examples.japanese: {親権|しんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧。
⟦{離婚|りこん}→離婚：02530_rikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{親権|しんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In cases of divorce, the mother often obtains custody.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最優先|さいゆうせん}→最優先：13012_saiyuusen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親権者|しんけんしゃ}→親権者：23602_shinkensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}する→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The court determines the custodial parent with the child's best interests as top priority.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, unlike many Western countries, joint custody after divorce has not traditionally been recognized — one parent is designated as the sole custodial parent (⟦{親権者|しんけんしゃ}→親権者：23602_shinkensha⟧). This has been a major topic of legal reform discussion. The word is a homophone of ⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧ (serious; real sword), which has a completely different meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親権|しんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have custody
- ⟦{親権者|しんけんしゃ}→親権者：23602_shinkensha⟧: custodial parent
- {親権|しんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧: to dispute custody
- {親権|しんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放棄|ほうき}する→放棄する：25353_houkisuru⟧: to relinquish parental rights
